The methods behind the OPDI data are described in the
[OPDI Algorithms](algorithms/index.qmd) section. It has one page per method,
each with how it is computed, what it was compared with, how accurate it is
and its limits. [Processing steps](algorithms/processing-steps.qmd) shows the
whole chain, and the [Data quality](accuracy/index.qmd) gives the accuracy of
every item on one page.

Methods of earlier releases: [Releases](data/releases.qmd).

[Track identity](algorithms/tracks.qmd) and
